sloka: अमात्यै: सह पौरैश्च गुरुभिश्च द्विजातिभि:।वनं सर्वं चरिष्यामि पद्भ्यां परिवृत: स्वयम् ॥ २.९८.५॥
transliteration: amātyai: saha pauraiśca gurubhiśca dvijātibhi:।vanaṁ sarvaṁ cariṣyāmi padbhyāṁ parivṛta: svayam ॥ 2.98.5॥

translations.english: 'I myself shall go on foot surrounded by ministers, citizens, preceptors and brahmins and search the entire forest.
